Add a reusable 24-case fault benchmark alternating normal calls with calls inside an outer except block.

limitations: Only completed fixed-budget probes and externally verified interpreter exits are counted as passed.
Resource samples include native libraries and allocators. Stable observations do not establish a strict RSS bound or absence of every leak.
Numerical parity covers CPU policies, optimizer state and native rollout tensors for three tasks and three seeds; it does not establish better policy quality.
Actual ACT and Microduck SDK tests passed; full GPU IsaacLab, RLinf and Weave training deployments were not run in this continuation.
The historical interpreter GC segmentation fault remains unresolved unless reproduced with actionable diagnostics; no GC disabling or forced os._exit is used.
Process ownership tests cover responsive POSIX filesystems and console sinks; they do not prove bounded teardown for an indefinitely stalled device.

A supplementary SDK host probe failed a strict graceful-marker assertion after 12600 fully verified scenarios; the worker was reaped and its run marked interrupted. Why it did not write the marker is not established. A deterministic stopped-worker test verified the production forced-stop fallback. The revised benchmark and three-minute SDK retry are recorded separately from the original three-hour strict probes.
